# MonthYearGridView

`Flare.Components.MonthYearGridView`

What a FlareMonthYearGrid lays out: the months of one year or the years of one decade.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Months` | `0` | The months of Year (12, or 13 in a Hebrew leap year). |
| `Years` | `1` | The twelve years of the decade that holds Year. |

- `FlareMonthYearGrid`
